composer.note: Use the Japanese official credit; Qobuz mistransliterates this credit as Takeru Sato.

noteLabels.zh: 采用官方日文署名“佐藤健”，对应本站既有作曲家条目。Qobuz将该名误转写成“Takeru Sato”，不据此建立演员身份。
noteLabels.en: The official Japanese credit 佐藤健 maps to the existing composer Ken Sato. Qobuz’s Takeru Sato transliteration is not used to infer an actor identity.

releaseDate.note: Original single date explicitly appears twice in the Sony-issued four-title announcement: under the section 国分友里恵の名曲「とばしてTaxi Man」が7インチで復刻！ and beside the DQKL-7127 track listing. The album date is independently confirmed by the Sony 2013 archive. OMV has a conflicting 1980-10-21 line.

noteLabels.en: Sony’s four-title announcement explicitly states the original single date, 1983-09-21, in both its Kokubu seven-inch section and DQKL-7127 listing. The album archive agrees. OMV says 1983 in prose but separately prints 1980-10-21; that conflict is preserved.
noteLabels.ja: ソニーの4作品合同リリースでは「国分友里恵の名曲『とばしてTaxi Man』が7インチで復刻！」の段落とDQKL-7127の曲目欄の両方に初出日1983-09-21を明記。アルバム資料も一致。OMVの本文1983年と別行1980-10-21の矛盾は記録します。
